results.title: Wonder Cement appoints Mahesh Singh to lead corporate brand communication
results.description: New Delhi: Wonder Cement has appointed Mahesh Singh as Vice-President, Corporate Brand Communication. His responsibilities will cover corporate brand strategy and communication, digital and performance marketing, public relations, trade engagement, events, exhibitions, sports and experiential marketing. Singh has more than two decades of experience in marketing and communications across automotive companies, agencies and entrepreneurship. He spent more than a decade at Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India, working across integrated communication, media, digital marketing, retail and consumer engagement. His responsibilities also included developing the company's digital marketing capabilities. He later joined dentsu X India as Vice President, Strategy & Planning. There, he worked across automotive, auto components, electric vehicles, FMCG, consumer electronics, BFSI and apparel, alongside brand consulting assignments. His agency responsibilities included media and marketing strategy, product launches, content, performance marketing and consumer activations. Singh subsequently pursued an entrepreneurial venture with Radiant Brands before joining Shriram Ltd. (SPR Autotech) as Head, Marketing & Communications. At Shriram, his remit covered brand and corporate strategy, communications, public relations, online reputation management, retail identity, loyalty programmes and events.

results.title: Diesel shortage emerges as bigger oil risk as global inventories fall: Crystol Energy
results.description: Christof Ruehl, Global Advisor at Crystol Energy, warns that diesel shortages could disrupt transport and industrial activity while fuelling inflation. He also flags the possibility of the US curbing diesel exports despite being a major producer, while spot oil prices remain well above future contracts, raising costs for buyers who need supplies immediately.

results.title: Rubio visits Portugal, praising 'great ally', looking to build deeper ties
results.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Portugal during his NATO allies tour, thanking Lisbon for supporting US operations through the strategically important Lajes Field air base while discussing defence cooperation and transatlantic relations.

results.title: Shankarabharanna | Song - Sakhiye
